t: Why he sent back a gift after one prayer
a: اذْهَبُوا بِخَمِيصَتِي هَذِهِ إِلَى أَبِي جَهْمٍ وَائْتُونِي بِأَنْبِجَانِيَّةِ أَبِي جَهْمٍ، فَإِنَّهَا أَلْهَتْنِي آنِفًا عَنْ صَلاَتِي
p: Idhhabū bi-khamīṣatī hādhihi ilā Abī Jahm, wa-ʾtūnī bi-anbijāniyyati Abī Jahm, fa-innahā alhatnī ānifan ʿan ṣalātī
m: Take this patterned cloak of mine to Abu Jahm and bring me Abu Jahm's plain one, for it just now distracted me from my prayer.
